contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

307-318AD. Roman, House of Constantine, probably Constantine I AE Follis. Length 24.4mm, Width 21.8mm, Thickness 1.9mm, Diameter 24.4mm, Weight 3.6g. Obverse: Laureate, cuirassed bust right. Inscription: (M)P CON (SA)UG. Reverse: Sol standing facing with whip and globe. Inscription: Illegible. Mint mark Illegible. Die Axis 180 deg. or 6 o'clock. Some wear and some corrosion with brown rusty surface stain/deposit. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2009, page 61 no. 598 and Identifying Roman Coins, Richard Reece and Simon James, Seaby 1986, Reprint 1994, page 26 & 27, No. 70 & 73
